BiblicalUsage: Buzi is named only as the father of Ezekiel the priest, to whom the word of the LORD came by the river Chebar in the land of the Chaldeans. The name matters because of the son: it anchors the prophet in a priestly family.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe God calls prophets out of real families, and Buzi is remembered because his son carried God's word to the exiles.
